method: TypeScript AST + markup candidates + literal module graph. Unknowns are not claims of completeness.

entries.markup: <span class="object-link object-observation-control object-thumbnail-leading object-result-row" role="link" aria-disabled="true" title="Not available yet">

<a class:list={['object-facility-image-link', entry.image.subject && 'object-facility-image-crop']}
                  style={entry.image.subject && `--frame-w:${entry.image.width};--frame-h:${entry.image.height};--subject-x:${entry.image.subject.left};--subject-y:${entry.image.subject.top};--subject-w:${entry.image.subject.width};--subject-h:${entry.image.subject.height}`}
                  href={entry.image.sourceUrl} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" aria-label={`${entry.title} artwork — ${entry.image.credit}`}>
<a class="object-facility-emblem" href={entry.emblem.sourceUrl} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" aria-label={`${entry.title} emblem — ${entry.emblem.credit}`}>

<div class="object-card-tabpanel"
          id={tabbed ? `${objectId}-${context.dataset.id}-${entry.id}-panel` : undefined}
          data-information-group={tabbed ? `context-${objectId}-${context.dataset.id}` : undefined}
          data-information-panel={tabbed ? entry.id : undefined}
          role={tabbed ? 'region' : undefined}
          aria-label={tabbed ? (byBand ? entry.band : entry.title) : undefined}
          tabindex={tabbed ? 0 : undefined}>

<button
            class="object-observation-control object-thumbnail-leading object-result-row"
            type="submit"
            form={`${objectId}-datasets`}
            name="dataset"
            value={dataset.id}
            aria-pressed={dataset.id === datasets.defaultDataset ? "true" : "false"}
            aria-controls={`${objectId}-${dataset.id}-details`}
            title={dataset.title}
          >

<div id={`${objectId}-${dataset.id}-option`} class="object-observation-option" data-dataset-option data-system-dataset={dataset.systemDataset ? dataset.id : undefined}
          data-step-group={dataset.step?.group} data-step-autoplay={dataset.step?.autoplay === false ? 'false' : undefined}
          data-step-listed={dataset.step ? String(listed(dataset)) : undefined} hidden={!listed(dataset) || undefined}>

<div
        id={`${objectId}-${dataset.id}-details`}
        data-dataset-details={page ? undefined : dataset.id}
        data-system-dataset-details={!page && dataset.systemDataset ? dataset.id : undefined}
        data-page-dataset-details={page ? dataset.id : undefined}
        hidden={dataset.id !== datasets.defaultDataset}
      >
<form id={`${objectId}-datasets`} action={route ?? undefined} method="get" data-dataset-form data-drawn-page={page} hidden>

<input class="object-native-tab" type="radio" name={`${idPrefix}-information`} id={`${idPrefix}-${tab.id}-tab`}
      data-information-tab={tab.id} data-information-group={group} value={tab.id} aria-controls={`${idPrefix}-${tab.id}-${panelSuffix}`} checked={tab.id === (initialTab ?? tabs[0]?.id)} />
<a class="object-learn-more-link" href={wikipediaLearnMoreUrl(title.label, articleUrl)} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
<a class="object-observation-control object-thumbnail-leading object-result-row" href={source.url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
<section class="object-results-scroll object-card-tabpanel" id={`${objectId}-bodies-content`} data-information-panel="bodies" aria-label="Celestial bodies">
<section class="object-results-scroll object-card-tabpanel object-sources-content" id={`${objectId}-sources-content`} data-information-panel="sources" aria-label="Sources">

<TreeDisclosure title="Datasets" class="object-card-tabpanel object-dataset-content" id={`${objectId}-dataset-content`} data-information-panel="dataset" data-system-view-datasets={systemDatasets || undefined} open>
<div id="object-category-results" class="object-results-scroll" role="region" aria-label="Search results" tabindex="0" hidden>
<a class="explorer-brand-version" title="GitHub" aria-label={`GitHub v${__CSSEARTH_VERSION__}`} href="https://github.com/layoutit/cssEarth" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
<a class="object-sidebar-search-clear" href={pageRoute ?? activeObject?.route} aria-label="Clear search" title="Clear search">
<a class="object-header-link" href="https://github.com/layoutit/cssEarth" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="GitHub" title="GitHub">
<a class="explorer-brand-version" title="GitHub" aria-label={`GitHub v${__CSSEARTH_VERSION__}`} href="https://github.com/layoutit/cssEarth" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">

<button
      class="object-search-category"
      type="submit" form={searchFormId} name="browse" value={category.label}
      data-search-query={category.label}
      data-search-classification={category.classification}
      aria-pressed="false"
    >

<button class="object-showcase-action" type="button" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Slideshow"
      title="Slideshow: fly between featured bodies until you take over">

<button class="object-header-action object-settings-action" type="button" popovertarget="object-settings"
      aria-label="Settings" title="Settings" aria-controls="object-settings">
<button type="button" class="object-diagnostic-record" data-diagnostic-record aria-label="Record diagnostic data" aria-pressed="false" hidden>

<form id={searchFormId} class="object-sidebar-search-card" role="search" aria-label="Object search"
        action={pageRoute ?? activeObject?.route} method="get" data-search-object={objectId} data-search-prompt={searchPlaceholder}>
<input class="object-sheet-handle" type="checkbox" aria-label="Expand information sheet" aria-controls={`${objectId}-information`} />

<input
          class="object-sidebar-search"
          type="search"
          name="q"
          maxlength={SEARCH_QUERY_LIMIT}
          placeholder={searchPlaceholder}
          aria-label={searchPlaceholder}
          aria-controls={`${objectId}-object-browser`}
          autocomplete="off"
        />

<input
        id="object-speed-setting"
        class="object-speed-setting"
        type="range"
        name={speedSetting.name}
        form="object-settings-form"
        min="0"
        max="4"
        step="1"
        value={initialSpeedValue}
        data-state={initialSpeedState}
        aria-label={`${speedSetting.label}: ${initialSpeedState}`}
        disabled
      />

<button class="object-dataset-play" type="button" data-dataset-play={dataset.step!.group} disabled
      aria-label="Play sequence" aria-pressed="false" title="Loop through this sequence">

<a class="object-attribution-footer object-source-link" data-source-link data-source-document={source.href} data-source-label={source.label}
  href={source.href} aria-label={source.label} title={source.label} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">

<div id={`${prefix}-bodies-content`} class="object-results-scroll object-card-tabpanel" data-view-part="system"
    role="region" aria-label={`Bodies in the ${card.system.name}`}>

<div id={`${prefix}-factsheet-content`} class="object-results-scroll object-card-tabpanel" data-view-part="system"
    data-information-panel="factsheet" data-information-group="system" role="region" aria-label="Factsheet">

<ObjectCardHeader title={{ label: card.system.name }} heading={false} introduction={card.system.description} data-view-part="system"
    data-source-subject={`object:${card.system.id}`} data-source-document={card.source.href} data-source-label={card.source.label}>

<main
          class:list={['object-stage', ...scene?.classes ?? []]}
          {...scene?.attributes}
          style={scene?.style}
          data-object-id={objectRecord.id}
          data-prepared-object={scene && !startup ? objectRecord.id : undefined}
          aria-label={`3D CSS view of ${objectRecord.name}`}
          set:html={startup ? '' : scene?.html ?? ''}
        />
<div class="native-scene-input" role="group" aria-label="Drag to turn, scroll to zoom">
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 300 90" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="13">
